weil:p3sw:ordinary-conversion.statement: {"hypotheses": ["a:Y->S is a polarized holomorphic abelian scheme of relative dimension six over a sufficiently small contractible smooth analytic germ with central fiber Y_0.", "alpha and the semiregular determinant-trivial twisted coherent B are those of p3sw:twisted-descent; set m=r^{12}, N=6+m-1."], "assertions": ["There exist a holomorphic P^{m-1}-bundle p:Z->Y, a determinant-trivial alpha-twisted vector bundle Q_0 of rank m on Y_0, and an inverse-twisted tautological line ell_0=O_{P(Q_0)}(1), with Z_0=P(Q_0). The projective-bundle convention parametrizes lines in Q_0.", "The ordinary relative anticanonical line H=omega_{Z/Y}^{-1}=det T_{Z/Y} has H|_{Z_0}=ell_0^m and restricts to O(m) on every p-fiber.", "zeta_{B,s}=c_1^B(H|_{Z_s})/m is horizontal, rational, of type (1,1), and restricts to the normalized hyperplane class. zeta_{H,s}=a_{H|_{Z_s}}/m maps to (2pi i)zeta_{B,s}. Every Z_s and p_s is projective algebraic, and a composed with p has a relative ample line.", "F_0=p_0^*B tensor ell_0 is ordinary coherent and semiregular; Ext\u00b2_{Z_0}(F_0,F_0) is isomorphic to the full twisted-derived Ext\u00b2(B,B), with sigma_{F_0}(p_0^*v)=exp(zeta_{H,0})p_0^*sigma_B(v).", "If kappa_B=sum_{k=0}^6 kappa_{B,k} is rational horizontal, specializes to ch_B(B), and is of type (k,k) in degree 2k, then A_B=p^*kappa_B exp(zeta_B)=sum_{k=0}^N A_{B,k} is rational, horizontal and of type (k,k). weil:p3sw:projective-germ.statement: {"hypotheses": ["S=(S,0) is a smooth complex analytic germ; pi:Xscript->S is a proper holomorphic submersion of relative dimension n with a holomorphic pi-ample line.", "F_0 is an ordinary coherent sheaf on X_0, and I is a subset of {1,...,n}.", "The full map sigma_{I,0}:Ext\u00b2(F_0,F_0)->direct_sum_{k in I} H^{k+1}(X_0,Omega^{k-1}_{X_0}), v maps to (Tr((a_{F_0}^{k-1}/(k-1)!)[2] composed with v))_k, is injective.", "For every k in I there is a rational flat section beta_{B,k} of R^{2k}pi_*Q with beta_{B,k}(0)=ch_{B,k}(F_0), and its flat de Rham lift itself lies in F^k(R^{2k}pi_*C tensor O_S)."], "assertions": ["After shrinking S, there is a coherent S-flat sheaf F on Xscript with F|_{X_0} isomorphic to F_0 and ch_{B,k}(F|_{X_s})=beta_{B,k}(s) for all nearby s and every k in I.", "These classes are rational algebraic cycle classes.", "No rank, simplicity, stability, local-freeness, reflexivity, or fixed-support hypothesis is imposed on F_0."], "limitations": "The source proves the smooth projective analytic-germ case for ordinary sheaves. It does not assert a general nonprojective or arbitrary-perfect-complex deformation theorem."}

weil:p3sw:bf-coefficients.statement: {"context": "Use the smooth projective-germ setup, central F_0, and assumed injective sigma_{I,0}. weil:p3sw:bf-one-step.statement: {"context": "In the same smooth projective-germ setup with injective sigma_{I,0}, fix nu>=0, A'=A_{nu+1}, A=A_nu, X=X_nu, X'=X_{nu+1}, J=m^{nu+1}/m^{nu+2}, and K=Omega\u00b9_{A'/C} tensor_{A'} A.", "hypotheses": ["E is an A-flat ordinary coherent sheaf on X with central fiber F_0.", "For every k in I, ch^{rel}_{H,k}(E)=tr(a_{X/A}(E)^k)/k! is the restriction of the Hodge edge of a flat F^k de Rham class on X'/A'."], "assertions": ["E has a coherent A'-flat sheaf lift on X' with its prescribed restriction to X."], "limitations": "Only the displayed successive thickenings of a smooth germ are covered, not arbitrary Artinian extensions or arbitrary perfect complexes."}

weil:p3sw:bf-artin-character.statement: {"hypotheses": ["In the same smooth projective analytic family, E_nu is any A_nu-flat coherent sheaf on X_nu with central fiber F_0."], "assertions": ["For every 0<=k<=n, under the ordinary flat comparison H^l_dR(X_nu/A_nu)=H^l(X_0,C) tensor_C A_nu, ch^{rel}_{H,k}(E_nu)=edge_k((2pi i)^k ch_{B,k}(F_0) tensor 1).", "The constant class (2pi i)^k ch_{B,k}(F_0) tensor 1 belongs to F^k H^{2k}_dR(X_nu/A_nu).", "These assertions are independent of the choice of E_nu."]}

weil:p3sw:local-algebraicity.statement: {"context": "K=Q(u), u\u00b2=-d, d>=3; Y_I is the marked seed-lattice family over the full compatible domain D for its transported rational K-action and hyperbolic Riemann/Hermitian form. kappa_B is the rational flat continuation of ch_B(B), with q^*kappa_B=kappa_M.", "assertions": ["On a nonempty analytic neighborhood of the seed in D, every component kappa_{B,j}(I), 0<=j<=6, is a rational algebraic cycle class on Y_I."]}

weil:p3sw:endpoint-two-generators.statement: {"hypotheses": ["A is an abelian sixfold with a unital action of an imaginary quadratic field K.", "A nonzero vector of its rational Weil plane W_K(A) is a rational algebraic class."], "assertions": ["Every vector of W_K(A) is a rational algebraic class."], "context": "The proof uses the two conjugate sixth exterior eigenspaces. It does not impose simplicity, endomorphism-generality, or a separately stated signature condition."}

weil:p3sw:spread.statement: {"hypotheses": ["pi:Xscript->S is a smooth projective morphism of relative dimension n over a smooth quasi-projective complex variety.", "nu:T->S^an is holomorphic, T is a connected complex manifold, and 0<=c<=n.", "Vbold is a finite-rank rational local subsystem of nu^*R^{2c}pi^an_*Q.", "For every t in a nonempty analytic open of T, every vector of Vbold_t is a rational algebraic codimension-c class on Xscript_{nu(t)}."], "assertions": ["The same algebraicity holds for every t in T."], "limitations": "The source does not require T, its image, or the pulled-back subsystem to be algebraic. The proof retains singular and nonreduced Hilbert parameter spaces."}

weil:p3sw:endpoint-all-lattices.statement: {"hypotheses": ["Fix K=Q(u), u\u00b2=-d with d>=3. A is any complex abelian sixfold with a unital K-action and a compatible polarization.", "Its actual homological second-linear form h_A(x,y)=e_A(x,uy)+u e_A(x,y) is hyperbolic."], "assertions": ["W_K(A) is a rational algebraic plane."], "limitations": "No simplicity or endomorphism-generality condition is imposed.
